rain.hint: strikes fall down columns of the screen — stand in an open column

wall.hint: a wall crosses the screen — slip through a gap

burst.hint: beams fan out from the boss — stand between them

spin.hint: beams sweep around the boss — keep moving with the gap

floor.hint: half the floor becomes deadly — cross to the other half

burrow.hint: a trail hunts you — step away before it erupts

boomerang.hint: it flies out and comes back — dodge it twice

quake.hint: a ring spreads from the boss — stand in its gap

combo.hint: three slams toward you, then a shockwave

strafe.hint: a charge down a marked lane leaves fire behind

eclipse.hint: darkness falls — blades strike from the dark

forge: Burrows — lava geysers rise under you
The bellows burst — the whole hall breathes fire
Floods the hall — islands of rock in scalding water
Boils it all — stay in the dry
Slag pours and walls you in
Armoured in cooling slag — break the shell
Chain lashes that pull you in
Wraps herself in chained spirits — free them
asg: The Allfather's Mask — mostly light: spears of light, shield-maidens at his call
The Cracked Mask — light and black in even beats; the dark half drags you in
The Storm That Ends the World — mostly black: gales and lightning sweep the throne room

vr.doing: Rushes you and throws a fan of arrows (scatter shot).
Circles you and hurls green bog-flame.
Charges, then sprays a spread of fire.
Slow; stomps shockwaves around itself.
Blinks around the room and fires homing hexes.
Strafes and calls lightning bolts.
Marches forward and fires scatter bolts.
Teleports and launches seeking shadow bolts.
Rushes in with cutlass slashes.
Stomps the ground — shockwave rings.
Heavy stomps that shake the cave floor.
Teleports and strikes with frost.
Drifts at you in swirling sparks.
Spits globs of lava.
Slow, crushing slams.
Fast swooping dives.
Lunges out of the lava.
Charges with sword lunges.
Lashes tentacles in fiery rings.
Hurls fire and drifts through walls of flame.
Fights in six forms, from the Molten Colossus to the Living Volcano.

vr.where: Goblin King · phase 2 · The Throne Warren
vr.doing: Charges, cleaves in a wide arc and hurls fire-pots.

vr.where: Dark Warlock · phase 2 · The Moonlit Canopy
vr.doing: Blinks around, fires fans of homing hexes and a sweeping beam.

vr.where: Swamp Witch · phase 2 · The Sunken Grotto
vr.doing: Poison clouds, lobbed brew and bog frogs; a ✨ ward only spells break.

vr.where: Swamp Witch · phase 3 · The Cauldron Pit
vr.doing: Leaps, tongue-pulls you in, drains life, calls leeches; ✨ ward and 🏹 guard.

vr.where: Storm Mage · phase 2 · The Cathedral Rooftop
vr.doing: Lightning beams, gusts that shove you to the edge; 🏹 guard only arrows break.

vr.where: Storm Mage · phase 3 · The Eye of the Storm
vr.doing: Gapped lightning rings, strikes if you stand still, storm sprites; ✨ ward.

vr.where: Rock Dragon · phase 2 · The Geode Hollow
vr.doing: Crystal breath, shard volleys that ricochet, crystal golemlings; 🛡 plate.

vr.where: Rock Dragon · phase 3 · The Chasm Bridge
vr.doing: Slams that crack the bridge, charges, falling rocks; 🛡 plate + ✨ ward.

vr.where: Rock Dragon · phase 4 · The Dragon's Summit
vr.doing: Fire breath, meteors, and two Crystal Drakelings fight beside it.
Darting lunges and crystal spit.

vr.where: Iron Sentinel · phase 2 · The Gear Hall
vr.doing: Hammer slams, mortar lobs, repair drones; 🛡 plate.

vr.where: Iron Sentinel · phase 3 · The Observatory Dome
vr.doing: Rotating star-beams, pulls you in, shock rings; 🛡 plate + 🏹 guard.

vr.where: Iron Sentinel · phase 4 · The Star Forge
vr.doing: Drill charges, beams, walls; two Forge Guardians fight with it.
Hammer slams that leave burning slag.

vr.where: Lava Titan · phase 2 · The Cooling Crust
vr.doing: Slams leave lava pools, lobbed magma, magma vents; 🛡 plate.

vr.where: Lava Titan · phase 3 · The Lava Falls Terrace
vr.doing: Glass-shard fans, reflecting armour, charred zombies; 🛡 plate + 🏹 guard.

vr.where: Lava Titan · phase 4 · The Caldera Rim
vr.doing: Charges, burning aura, meteor marks; ✨ ward + 🛡 plate + 🏹 guard.

vr.where: Lava Titan · phase 5 · The Heart of the Volcano
vr.doing: Fire rings, meteors, lava everywhere; two Magma Titans guard it.

vr.where: Shadow Lord · phase 2 · The Shattered Sanctum
vr.doing: Blind clouds, homing shadows, drain; ✨ ward.

vr.where: Shadow Lord · phase 3 · The Hall of Mirrors
vr.doing: Sword combos, swaps places with you, mirror echoes; 🛡 plate + 🏹 guard.

vr.where: Shadow Lord · phase 4 · The Starless Void
vr.doing: Twin beams, gravity pull, void rifts, shadow wraiths; ✨ ward + 🏹 guard + 🛡 plate.

vr.where: Shadow Lord · phase 5 · The Dawn Altar
vr.doing: Everything at once — and two Shadow Twins fight beside it.
Blinks and fires homing shadow bolts.
Charges and slashes; thorns hurt when you hit him up close.
Fast rapier combos and a dazzling sun-flash.
Heavy slams and thrown grain sacks.
Water beams and poison spit from the pools.
Rings of water and summoned drowned monks.
Root slams and vine pulls.
Hammer slams that leave burning slag; tough armour.
Freezing beams and ice walls.
Dives from above and blasts you with wind.
Chain pulls, slams and reflecting armour.
Fire rings, meteors and burning ground.
Raises bone minions and hurls cursed skulls.
❄️ Frost bolts slow you · 🧊 Rime floor — patches of ice you slide across · ✨ Blinks away when you close in
📚 Homing arcane missiles · 🪞 Mirror images — two copies of him that hit weakly · ✨ Blinks around the room
🔥 Fireballs leave burning ground · 🔥 Rings of flame spread out from her
🌿 Thorns root you in place · 🪢 Vines pull you to him · 💚 Slowly heals
⚡ Lightning beams · ⚡ Stand still and lightning finds you · ⚡ Spark volleys
🧊 Turns the floor into an ice rink — you slide · ❄️ Freezing beam · 🔹 Bouncing ice shards
☠️ Poison clouds · 🐸 Her hex turns you into a frog (slow, weak) · 🐸 Calls frogs to fight for her
🌊 Waves shove you across the room · 🌊 Rings of water · 🧱 Walls of water block your path
💥 Novas of flame burst out of her · ☄️ Burning star-marks rain on you · ✨ Blinks away
🌑 Darkness — you go blind; only his glowing eyes show · 🔮 Slow void orbs follow you · ✨ Blinks in the dark
⚡ Teleports next to you and slams · ⚡ Stunning sparks · ⚡ Lightning if you stand still
🪨 Earth spikes burst up under you · 🧱 Raises stone walls · 🔻 Shrinking curse (you deal less damage) · 🛡 Stone armour
🌨 Blizzards slow everything · 🧊 Ice floors everywhere — you slide · ❄️ Freezing beam · ❄️ Rings of frost
🌑 Blinds you — the room goes dark · 🔀 Hexes that reverse your controls · 🟣 Void beams · 🪞 Echo copies of himself
🩸 Drains your life to heal herself · 💘 Charm — your controls reverse · 🦇 Homing blood-bats · ✨ Blinks
🌠 Starfall — meteors rain on marked spots · ⏳ Slows time around you · ✨ Blinks among the stars
breathing fire in sweeps, burrowing under the coals
hurling steam bolts, flooding the hall with scalding water
pouring slag and hurling molten boulders
lashing chains and dragging you in
spears of light; then the cracked mask, half light, half dark; at last the storm that ends the world.

diff.name: Hearthside
diff.tag: A tale told by the fire
diff.text: Gentler foes, smaller packs and slower bosses with long warnings. For a first journey.

diff.name: Wayfarer
diff.tag: The road as it was meant to be walked
diff.text: The balanced journey: the game as it has played until now.

diff.name: Shieldbearer
diff.text: Bosses have half again the health, warn less and strike sooner. Monsters are tougher and come in bigger packs.

diff.name: Ragnarök
diff.text: Bosses have more than twice the health, barely warn, add an extra wave to their attacks and make their last stand early. Monsters hit hard and swarm.
